H0: Conditional on the abelian (congruence) part of the labels, the non-abelian parts of the labels of p_n and p_(n+k) are independent, each with its Chebotarev / Sato-Tate law, for every k, every gap and every order in 1/log x (relative corrections O(x^(-1/2+eps)), heuristic); equivalently N2 = LOS on the abelian part x independent Chebotarev draws inside the fibres.
H1: none derived (no non-abelian main term exists at fixed shifts; see consec.md 2.3)

decisions.D1a: pooled contingency chi^2 of the fibre labels inside abelian fibres (consec_analyze "indep"), all schemes, k = 1, 2, 3: pass if p >= 1e-3; H0 falsified if p < 1e-5
decisions.D1b: every fibre-interaction cell (consec_analyze "corr", k = 1, 2, 3, all function pairs, centred r): |z| < 4.5 passes; H0 falsified if any |z| >= 5
decisions.D1c: within part of the per-block (1e4) fibre transition tables (consec_analyze "w4"): inverse-variance pooled mean over the schemes within 4 errors of 1 (H0); each scheme within 4.5 errors; H0 falsified if the pooled mean is > 5 errors from 1
decisions.D2: gap-conditioned lag-1 interaction: each scheme and function chi^2 p >= 1e-3; each gap = 0 mod q contrast |z| < 4
decisions.D3: non-abelian label against the abelian datum of the neighbour (consec_analyze "nbr"): every |z| < 4.5
decisions.D4: run lengths in the fibre subsequence against the geometric law: each scheme total p >= 1e-3
decisions.D5: first-third interaction given the middle label (consec_analyze "triple"): each scheme p >= 1e-3
decisions.D6: short-shift dispersion (column part at H = 1e2, 1e3): every non-abelian function R within 4 errors of 1; inverse-variance pooled R per H within 4 errors of 1 (a BKS-C2-type constant would give about 1 - 0.42/log x = 0.979)
decisions.H0_verdict: H0 stands if D1a, D1b, D1c, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6 pass; H0 is falsified only by the falsifier clauses of D1a, D1b, D1c; a failure of D2-D6 without a falsifier is reported as an open anomaly
